who_what.text: The official repository describes the folder as a Google ADK and Gemini always-on memory sample. The parent repository says its code samples are demonstrative and not an officially supported Google product. The checked project README does not identify an individual maintainer.

architecture.text: agent.py builds an ADK orchestrator with ingest, consolidation, and query specialist agents; a local SQLite database; an inbox poller; a periodic consolidation task; and an aiohttp API. dashboard.py is a separate Streamlit client.

SQLite memories contain source, raw text, summary, JSON entities/topics/connections, importance, creation time, and a consolidated flag. Consolidations hold source IDs, summary, insight, and timestamp; processed_files tracks paths and processing times. The schema has no tenant or user key.

IngestAgent asks Gemini to structure input; ConsolidateAgent proposes cross-record connections and insights; QueryAgent reads recent records and is prompted to cite numeric memory IDs. No vector store or embedding code appears in the inspected implementation.

behavior.text: Text can be posted to /ingest or found by the inbox poller; supported media is sent as multimodal bytes. Watched text is truncated to 10,000 characters and media above 20 MiB is skipped. Each accepted write inserts a new memory; no general update or deduplication path was found.

The consolidation timer defaults to 30 minutes and invokes the model when at least two rows are unconsolidated. The agent reads at most ten newest rows, writes a new consolidation, appends model-supplied links, and marks supplied IDs consolidated.

Query reads at most 50 newest memories and ten newest consolidations; the inspected reader does not rank rows against the question. QueryAgent is asked to synthesize only from those results and cite memory IDs, but citation support and abstention were not evaluated.

The API deletes one row by ID or clears memories, consolidations, processed-file markers, and non-hidden files under the inbox. These paths show no tombstone or mutation history; deletion completeness beyond these stores was not established.

metrics.evidence: The source provides a recent-record context window, but no answerable or unsupported query workload was run.
A general memory update path was not found in the inspected file; no correction or stale-value probes were run.
Single-row and full-reset deletion code is visible, but no leakage checks were run across copies, logs, or backups.
The inspected schema has no tenant/user key and HTTP routes show no auth layer; no runtime boundary probes or deployment review were run.
The query prompt requests memory-ID citations, but no claim-to-record support adjudication was done.
The dashboard displays elapsed action time; no workload latency distribution or write-to-recall delay was measured.
No vector index is used in inspected code, but no token, provider cost, or storage measurements were collected.
Source exposes polling interval, bounded text/media sizes, read/consolidation limits, count statistics, logs, and dashboard request timing. These are design observations, not performance results.

limits.text: This was a bounded source review of the project README, agent.py, and dashboard.py at the pinned monorepo commit. ADK internals, deployment controls, service-side retention, concurrent load, backups, and other configurations were not inspected. The app, tests, and benchmarks were not run.
Answer quality, supported evidence, abstention, effective isolation in deployment, deletion completeness, throughput, latency, provider cost, and storage use remain unknown from this inspection.
